name: usage-limit-auto-resume
description: Safely resumes same-agent work after a recognized usage-limit failure.

scripts.build: esbuild index.server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=node_modules/.cache/usage-limit-auto-resume/index.server.cjs --external:@getpaseo/plugin --external:@getpaseo/plugin/server --external:zod --log-level=warning && npm run build:pace-read && echo build ok
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
